source.description: Toy plan for a personal image gallery. Requirements REQ1 through REQ5 map in order to the feature list.

outcomes.text: Users retain their profile and cover images.
Users can manage and retrieve their gallery images.

slices.title: Upload a profile photo
slices.behavior: A saved profile photo is visible after reloading.

acceptance.check: A saved profile photo is visible after reloading.
acceptance.observable: Upload a photo, reload the profile, and see the same photo.

slices.title: Upload a cover image
slices.behavior: A saved cover image is visible after reloading.

acceptance.check: A saved cover image is visible after reloading.
acceptance.observable: Upload a cover, reload the page, and see the same cover.

slices.title: Delete an image
slices.behavior: A deleted image no longer appears after reloading.

acceptance.check: A deleted image no longer appears after reloading.
acceptance.observable: Delete an image, reload, and confirm it is absent.

slices.title: Browse a gallery
slices.behavior: The gallery displays saved profile and cover images.

acceptance.check: The gallery displays saved profile and cover images.
acceptance.observable: Open the gallery after both uploads and see both images.

slices.title: Download an image
slices.behavior: The gallery download returns the original image bytes.

acceptance.check: The gallery download returns the original image bytes.
acceptance.observable: Download from the gallery and compare the bytes with the uploaded file.
